name: v8-r6-spo-v3
description: Cell R-6 (plan section 9, N 46; spo trial 3): target-tracking optimiser spo-v3 (S-8; lane R6, task-R-6-report.md, part 2 built): minimise (gamma/2)(w - w_aim)' Sigma (w - w_aim) + trade cost / H + borrow, w_aim = L x desired of the accepted rule, Sigma atx-risk-v1.1 on the 4-year role, gamma = S_prior / sigma_aim with S_prior = 20 (Ruling E-14, amended before any read), H = 20, gross bound 2 L slack. Ruling E-26: spo-v3 takes a parent's --hold-band / --adv-hold-q (R-4 or R-5 accepted) on the desired target, so the parent's NAV flags stay. The change: nav --rule spo-v3 --spo-alpha implied-aim --risk-model <atx-risk-v1.1, 4-year role> --risk-model-sha256 <pin> --spo-books primary, and no --capacity-curve (spo refuses it). NAV-only: u, fit, card and w are the parent's. Before any return: identities (flag off; spo-v1 and spo-v2 digests) and v7_extras.json spo_v3.tripwire.status == clear and spo_v3.tripwire.limits_unmet_primary.count == 0 (Ruling E-31a: a scored decision of the primary book with its net or beta limit unmet voids the run whatever --specific-ceiling-void: exit 3, v7_extras.json voided limits_unmet with the count and first session, no NAV or returns file, no Sharpe; --spo-iters and --spo-tol are refused, the solver constants are registered). Acceptance: dSR > 0 AND mechanics AND cost per traded dollar not higher AND tripwire clear AND mean corr(traded book after decision d's trades, aim at d) over scored decisions >= .9 (Ruling E-14, E-14a: v7.spo_v3_books.<primary>.aim_correlation_traded_after.mean).
